notes.title: Detective Camie
notes.content:
Detective Camie is a video game with a lot of freedom.

You can explore the fictional city of Kowa to resolve crime the way you want.

You also have a lot of side quests and a lot of colorful characters to meet.

The game is a point-and-click with a lot of variety in the gameplay.

The game may have a serious tone but also have a lot of silly endings or stories on the side.

The game should be out in 2024.
